source: Horatio: I find that strangely charming. And possibly seductive. Othello: Hmph. Well, I'm certain there's many a man willing to... grab your head around here. Othello: Toward the end of my decade, I was one of the Sultan's own viziers. I had gardens and treasures aplenty. This feels like a different world entirely. Horatio: You gave up all that to come to this rotten, pasty little country? Why on earth? Othello: Because it was not truly mine. I was an Ottoman slave. Everything I did was in my master's name, even when I surpassed his rank with my own.
target: 霍拉旭: 奇怪的是，我觉得这还挺有魅力。说不定还挺撩人。 奥赛罗: 哼。嗯，我敢肯定，这儿有不少男人都愿意……抓住你的脑袋。 奥赛罗: 那十年快结束时，我已经是苏丹麾下的一名高级大臣了。我拥有许多花园和珍宝。这里简直像另一个世界。 霍拉旭: 你放弃了那一切，跑到这个腐烂、满是苍白面孔的小国家来？到底为什么？ 奥赛罗: 因为那一切并不真正属于我。我是奥斯曼帝国的奴隶。我做的每一件事都以主人的名义，即便我的地位已经超过了他。
